title: Give the player a to-do list
blurb: Your island gets a checklist, and things tick off as the player does them.
how: TASKS is a list with one row for each thing the player has to do. id is the short name your code uses. name is what the player reads.
yield island_tasks(TASKS) hands the list to the game. Do it in @on_start.
yield task_done("president") ticks off the row with that id. Put it right after the thing actually happens.
The player opens the list by clicking the line at the top of the screen.
try: Rename both tasks, then check the list in the game.
Add a third task for the computer (the_desk). You need a new row in TASKS and a new @on_talk block.
When the player talks to the president after finishing everything, have the president say something different. Guide 3 has what you need.
breaks: The id in task_done doesn't match any id in TASKS. Check the spelling.
